option_relations.rationale: The option describes epididymo-orchitis with abscess formation, which is a different condition than the hemorrhagic infarction of the testicular appendage described in the leaf.
The option describes hemorrhagic infarction of the testis, while the leaf specifies hemorrhagic infarction of the testicular appendage (appendix testis). These are distinct anatomical structures.
